change: terraform.yml, a reusable workflow that applies a Terraform stack from the default branch (on a push there, or by hand), as a Google account it gets through Workload Identity Federation (inputs workload-identity-provider and service-account; callers grant id-token: write and pull-requests: read): it plans to a file and applies exactly that plan, one run at a time, with the plan in the job's summary. Nothing runs for a pull request, for another ref, or until the repository variable TERRAFORM_CI is on. The job runs in the environment named by environment (terraform), which the caller limits to the default branch, so a provider can trust the token's subject repo:OWNER/REPO:environment:terraform alone (or its immutable form). A plan that deletes anything, replacements included, is applied only when the merged pull request has the label terraform-destroy. With secrets (the default) every terraform command runs through ./pubkit secrets run with the environment's secret BWS_ACCESS_TOKEN; with secrets: false terraform runs plainly
